name: Event e Ikou! Sono 9
original_name: イベントへ行こう!その9
source:
Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102892.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=2098]Kan'u Unchou[/url] from Ikkitousen.
translation:
去參加同人展，並與角色扮演者發生性關係！
這位女孩扮成你最喜歡的角色，就像從作品裡走出來一樣，千萬別錯過！

［來自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ102892.html]DLsite[/url]］

登場角色為《一騎當千》的[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=2098]關羽雲長[/url]。
